title: 易·镜片保养日
description: 绿色甲衣无极剑圣坐着擦拭备用小镜片，标志多眼护目镜戴好，长剑入鞘靠架。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Master Yi is an adult Ionian swordsman with a distinctive gold multi-lens goggle helmet, a covered calm face, a long dark hair tail, and green-gold martial armor. Preserve the cluster of round eye lenses and slim upright silhouette through fully covering layered clothing, gloves, opaque trousers, and boots. His curved sword remains safely sheathed and supported beside the bench.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a low veranda bench and polishes one spare round lens with a soft square cloth, holding it away from his face to admire the clean surface. A little closed tool box and tea cup sit nearby. Bamboo and a pale screen form a quiet background, with no sword swing or martial demonstration.
art_direction.palette: jade green, muted gold, dark brown, pale cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
